drivingQuestion: Is the mishna's 'moist' natural moisture or any moisture?
outcomeNote: proofs attempted in the next unit

segments.he: בִּזְמַן שֶׁהֵן לַחִין. אִיבַּעְיָא לְהוּ: לַחִין מֵחֲמַת עַצְמָן, אוֹ דִילְמָא לַחִין מֵחֲמַת דָּבָר אַחֵר.
segments.en: The mishna listed several materials in which food may not be insulated on Shabbat eve «when» those materials «are moist. A dilemma was raised» before the Sages: Is the mishna referring specifically to materials that are «moist due to their own» natural state, «or» is it referring «perhaps» even to materials that «are» now «moist due to something else,» e.g., because they were soaked by liquid?
